Coram : KURIAN JOSEPH*, R.F. NARIMAN
Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 - s.24(2) - Lapse of land acquisition proceedings under the 1894 Act - Deeming provision -Acquisition of respondent's land in 1986- Compensation not paid to the land owner but deposited in for contingency as contemplated u/s. 31 (2) of the 1894,Act compelling the said deposit made out - Held: Such deposit in Court cannot be treated as a payment of compensation to land owners for the purpose of s.24(2) of the 2013 Act - Payment of compensation/deposit in Court has to be made as per
Decision Date : 31-08-2016 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 8477/2016 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
